title: Kenyan Herb Rice
community: Urban Kenya — the hotel restaurant rice side
author: Chef Amina Hassan
desc: Kenyan Herb Rice — fluffy basmati rice cooked by the absorption method, finished with a generous herb oil of fresh coriander, parsley, garlic, and lemon. The restaurant rice side that transforms every main course it accompanies.
longDesc: Herb rice is the unsung hero of the restaurant table — perfectly cooked fluffy rice, finished with a vibrant herb oil, that elevates any main course it accompanies. The key is the absorption method and the quality of the herb oil applied at the end.
ingredients: ½ cup fresh coriander — finely chopped
steps: Combine herb oil ingredients. Set aside.
Bring water and salt to a boil in a saucepan.
Add rinsed rice. Stir once. Return to a boil.
Reduce to lowest heat. Cover tightly.
Cook for 18 minutes — do not lift the lid.
Remove from heat. Rest covered for 5 minutes.
Fold herb oil through the rice gently.
Taste and adjust salt and lemon.
chefTips: Never lift the lid during cooking — the steam is what cooks the rice.
The herb oil must be added hot rice — it wilts the herbs slightly and blooms the garlic.
Fold gently — do not stir or the rice becomes gluey.
commonMistakes: Lifting the lid — steam escapes and rice is undercooked.
Stirring after adding herbs — gluey texture.
cookingScience: The absorption method traps steam inside the covered pot — the rice cooks through a combination of absorbed water and steam condensation. The starches gelatinise evenly when undisturbed, producing the fluffy, separate-grain texture. Stirring after cooking ruptures the swollen starch granules, releasing amylose — creating stickiness.
sustainabilityTips: The herb oil uses fresh herbs that would otherwise wilt — a zero-waste approach.
servedWith: Every main course in this category
storage: Refrigerate 3 days. Add a splash of water when reheating.
reheating: Microwave with a damp cloth on top, or steam briefly.
healthBenefits: Basmati rice has a lower GI than regular white rice.
culturalNote: Herb rice demonstrates that the side dish matters — at Kenya's finest hotels, no main course arrives with plain boiled rice. The herb oil and perfect cooking technique make it a dish in its own right.
